lines.2: We have PE on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
lines.3: 「Is everyone smiling? Smiles are important, you know.」
lines.4: 「A flexible lesson plan is my motto. It is unusually hot today, so how about we simply observe the girls? I think it would brighten our day.」
lines.6: 「Then let us go cheer them on at once. Remember, cheer with a smile.」
lines.7: The boys head to the gym.
lines.8: The girls are busy playing something called volleyball.
lines.10: 「Ah, what a lovely view. 'Abuse of authority' has such a wonderful ring to it.」
